content:
Black Friday is already in full force with Amazon’s massive official sale event and there is absolutely no shortage of Apple deals. Alongside the lowest prices ever on every Apple Watch Series 12 config, the Mac deals are wild this week with as much as $250 off the brand new M6 MacBook Pro and PROLED XDR MacBook Pro, while, perhaps even more universally exciting, the most affordable M5 MacBook Air is $250 off and MacBook Neo is down at just $649.

Joining the very first discounts on Apple’s brand new OLED iPad mini, the Beats discounts are overflowing and headlined by the all-new Beats 360 with $100 price drop, but we also have AirPods Pro 3 at $70 off and AirPods Max 2 down even lower at $130 off. Just be sure to scope out the popular new Twelve South AirFly Drive Wireless CarPlay Adapter at the $32 all-time low and giant collection of MagSafe chargers we have for you down below as well.
